description: Modular skill set that audits a brand's website for AI-crawler and AI-agent readiness: renderability, content noise, discoverability, structured-data completeness, and crawl-compliance posture.

skills.name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
skills.summary: Master orchestrator that sequences every sub-skill and emits the final audit report.

skills.name: website-observer
skills.summary: Low-overhead HTTP/DOM inspection without JavaScript execution.

skills.name: failure-diagnostics
skills.summary: Maps raw technical signals to the Web Failure Ontology to produce scored findings.

skills.name: crawl-render-audit
skills.summary: Headless Playwright/Chromium rendering, scroll/interaction driving, and shadow-DOM traversal.

skills.name: query-guided-discovery
skills.summary: Multi-page internal link scoring and fragmented-information discovery.

skills.name: freshness-corroboration
skills.summary: Aggregates evidence, corroborates findings, runs coverage/validation meta-analysis, and emits the final floor-schema JSON audit report.
